action_summary: Set CONVERT_TO_RANK back to False, since the last direct comparison (v17 vs v18) and v15 vs v16 both show rank conversion lowering the score and raw probability averaging gave the best historical score. Added horizontal-flip test-time augmentation (average of sigmoid outputs of the original and width-flipped image) in run_inference_loop, controlled by a USE_HFLIP_TTA flag, as the labels are invariant to left-right flips. Made model loading robust by inspecting the checkpoint state-dict keys and instantiating SingleHeadModel (head_fc keys) or MultiHeadResNeXt (head_i keys) accordingly, filtering settings.yml params to those each class accepts, so the best-scoring multi-head weights are used if that is what the weights dataset contains.
